passage.label: O believed protect yourselves families Fire fuel people stones over which angels harsh severe not disobey Allah commands do what commanded; O disbelieved make no excuses Day recompensed what used do; O believed repent Allah sincere repentance perhaps Lord remove misdeeds admit gardens rivers flow Day Allah not disgrace Prophet believed with him light proceed before right say Our Lord perfect us light forgive us indeed You over all competent; O Prophet strive against disbelievers hypocrites harsh upon them refuge Hell wretched destination

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ قُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيكُمۡ نَارٗا وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلۡحِجَارَةُ عَلَيۡهَا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةٌ غِلَاظٞ شِدَادٞ لَّا يَعۡصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمۡ وَيَفۡعَلُونَ مَا يُؤۡمَرُونَ
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَعۡتَذِرُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوۡبَةٗ نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمۡ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمۡ وَيُدۡخِلَكُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ يَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡزِي ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِيَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥۖ نُورُهُمۡ يَسۡعَىٰ بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَبِأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتۡمِمۡ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ جَٰهِدِ ٱلۡكُفَّارَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱغۡلُظۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

mainSubject.label: Believers commanded to protect themselves and their families from a Fire fuelled by people and stones, overseen by harsh angels who never disobey divine commands; disbelievers told to offer no excuses on that Day since they will only be recompensed for their deeds; believers urged toward sincere repentance so their Lord may remove misdeeds and admit them to rivered gardens on the Day the Prophet and his fellow believers are not disgraced, their light proceeding before them and on their right while they pray for its perfection and forgiveness; the Prophet commanded to strive harshly against disbelievers and hypocrites whose refuge is Hell, a wretched destination

Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the better-wives substitution scenario (5) before the fire-protection command opens (6); P2 ends with the jihad-harshness command and Hell-refuge verdict (9) before the four-women exempla block begins (10); P3 covers the two disbelieving and two believing women exemplars (10-12).
